title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (June, 2026)
summary: June 2026 cumulative updates for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central are released across versions BC28, BC27, and BC26, with BC28 CU02 as the latest update. The post provides version details, release dates, lifecycle information, and support timelines for current and historical releases.
key_points: BC28 CU02 released for 2026 Release Wave 1 with both cloud (SaaS) and on-premises versions available
BC27 CU08 and BC26 CU14 released for 2025 release waves with specific application and platform build numbers
2026 release wave 1 (version 28.x) started April 1, 2026 and is in support until October 13, 2027
Multiple older versions (BC25 through BC14) are now end-of-life, with their support timelines documented
On-premises versions follow Modern Lifecycle Policy with defined start and end dates for each release wave
features: Managing Production and Sandbox Environments in the Admin Center

quotes.text: Cumulative Update (June, 2026) for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is now released.
quotes.why_it_matters: Marks the official release announcement of the June 2026 cumulative updates across multiple BC versions

quotes.text: Dynamics 365 Business Central on-premises (Modern Policy) follows the Modern Lifecycle Policy.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the support policy framework for on-premises deployments, affecting maintenance obligations
